analitica.sinAnterior: no data for the previous period
analitica.verTabla: See the data as a table
analitica.sinDatos: No traffic data yet: the counter started on 21 October 2026.
analitica.nota: Counted in our own database, no cookies or IP: page type, whether it was the first of the visit, the referring site, and per visit the country (from Vercel), browser, OS, device, language, screen width, theme and campaign, reduced to labels. Active users are signed-in people; crawlers don't count. People with “Do Not Track” aren't counted.

analitica.sinCampanas: No visits with utm_source in this period.
analitica.mapaCalor: Page views by day and hour (Madrid time)
analitica.webAppNota: People who use both count in both.
analitica.sinVitales: No performance data yet: collection starts with this version.
analitica.vitalesNota: Web Vitals measured in people's browsers (period average). Ratings are Google's: ideally over 75% should be “Good”.

analitica.botsNota: Only bots that run JavaScript reach the counter; the rest aren't seen at all. None count as visits.

registro.vacio: Nothing to show with these filters.
registro.nota: Kept for 30 days. Written by the cron, failed syncs, alerts, your admin actions and errors people see on the website.

acciones.lanzarCronAyuda: Runs a sync pass right away, without waiting for its schedule. It takes a few minutes; the result shows up in Log.
acciones.avisoPush: Also send by push and Discord
acciones.cuentasProblemaAyuda: Tried in the last 24 h, but more than 2 days without a successful sync.
acciones.pausasAyuda: If a platform is down or erroring (e.g. OpenXBL), pausing it avoids cascading failures. The app keeps showing what's already saved.
